hero.headline: Your child's world, always understood
hero.subheadline: Myndigo helps parents of children with autism keep everything important in one place — and share it instantly with anyone who needs it.
hero.ctaSub: Free forever. No credit card. Never commercialised.

features.title: Everything a caregiver needs to know
features.subtitle: From emergency contacts to sensory triggers — Myndigo keeps it organised, secure, and shareable in seconds.

items.title: Critical alerts first
items.description: Allergies, epilepsy, diabetes, elopement risk — the most important information is always shown at the top, impossible to miss.

items.title: Communication profile
items.description: Let others know how your child communicates — verbal, non-verbal, AAC device, echolalia — and exactly how to speak to them.

items.title: Triggers & de-escalation
items.description: Document what causes distress and what actually helps. Give any caregiver the tools to handle a difficult moment with confidence.

items.title: Emergency contacts
items.description: Tap-to-call contacts right on the shared page. No searching, no delays — just one tap to reach the right person.

items.title: Routines & sensory needs
items.description: Explain your child's routines, what disrupts them, and which sounds, lights, or textures cause discomfort.

items.title: Medical information
items.description: Medications, allergies, conditions, and doctor contacts — all in one place, always up to date.

items.title: You control what's shared
items.description: Every section can be toggled on or off. Show what's relevant, keep the rest private. You're always in control.

items.title: Works in any language
items.description: The shared profile can be viewed in 10 languages. A first responder anywhere in the world can understand your child's needs.

steps.title: Create a profile
steps.description: Add your child's information — alerts, communication style, triggers, medical details, and emergency contacts.

steps.title: Choose what to share
steps.description: Toggle each section on or off. Only what you choose will appear on the shared page.

steps.title: Share via QR or NFC
steps.description: Print the QR code on a card, badge, or backpack tag. Or program an NFC chip. One scan opens the profile instantly.

steps.title: Always up to date
steps.description: Update any detail in the app and it's live immediately. No need to reprint or reshare — the QR code stays the same.

shareDemo.title: What a first responder sees
shareDemo.subtitle: The shared profile is designed to give the most critical information in under 3 seconds — no login, no app required.

privacy.title: Built with privacy at the core
privacy.subtitle: Your child's data is among the most sensitive information that exists. We treat it that way.

items.title: End-to-end access control
items.description: Row-level security ensures your data is only ever accessible by you. Not even our team can read it.

items.title: Anonymous share links
items.description: Shared profiles use random tokens, never record IDs. Profiles can't be guessed or enumerated.

items.title: No tracking on shared pages
items.description: The shared profile page has no advertising, no third-party tracking, and no cookies.

items.title: Delete everything, anytime
items.description: Your account and all associated data can be permanently deleted in one click. No questions asked.

notifications.title: Know when your profile is viewed
notifications.description: Every time someone scans your child's QR code, Myndigo logs the view and can notify you by email — so you always know when the profile is being used.

items.a: Yes, Myndigo is free to use. Create an account and add your child's profile at no cost.

items.q: Does the viewer need to install anything?
items.a: No. The shared profile opens directly in any browser. No app, no account, no login required.

items.q: What if I need to update information urgently?
items.a: Changes are live immediately. Open the app, update the detail, and anyone scanning the QR code will see the new information straight away.

items.q: Can I stop sharing at any time?
items.a: Yes. You can disable sharing with one tap. The QR code and NFC chip will stop working instantly. Re-enable sharing just as easily.

items.q: What happens if someone finds the QR code?
items.a: They can only see the information you've chosen to share. You control every section. You can also regenerate the QR code at any time to invalidate the old one.

items.q: Is my child's data stored securely?
items.a: Yes. All data is encrypted at rest and in transit. Row-level security policies mean your data is only accessible to your account.

items.q: Can I add more than one child?
items.a: Yes. You can add as many children as you need, each with their own profile and QR code.
The parent portal and shared profile support English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Italian, Arabic, Chinese, Japanese, and Polish.

cta.title: Give every caregiver the information they need
cta.subtitle: It takes about 10 minutes to set up a complete profile. That 10 minutes could make all the difference.

footer.tagline: Helping ASD families feel understood, everywhere.
